summary: Version 0.5.0 is live: a strip of key figures and the stage of the IPO at the top, a panel bar with ten panels that scrolls by itself on a phone, and four panels from the filing (SHARES, UNLOCK, CONTROL, TIMELINE). 56 new FILED facts, 3 calculations, 30 new consistency checks (159 in all). The value at the IPO price stays on a phone's first screen. Not run: the owner's look at the new page.
delivered: Header: the project's own mark, a strip of six key figures (price range, shares offered, amount raised, value, reported pricing and trading dates) and a stage bar (filed, priced, trading, unlock) driven by events the service sees.
Panel bar with ten panels (keys s, u, k, t added); on a phone it scrolls inside itself and the page never scrolls sideways.

SHARES: new shares, sellers, underwriters' option and private placement as columns and a table; holders after the IPO (91.0% / 6.3% / 2.7%); the 22 underwriters, allocation shown as blank in this filing; insiders' indicated interest up to $303 million.
UNLOCK: the filing's 23-step lock-up schedule as a chart and as the filing's table with its wording; not dated, not summed.
CONTROL: votes by class (Class F 50.1%, Class A 49.9%, of which the IPO shares about 5.5%); Class T elects a majority of the board; Class N no vote; Class E limited matters.
TIMELINE: filings from EDGAR's live list, same form in a row on one line, then the reported pricing and first trade, then the first unlock.
extract.py _structure: 56 FILED facts with page and passage; calc.py: deal.shares_all, holders.placement_after_pct, control.ipo_votes_pct; reconcile.py: 30 new checks.
Released with it: the after-hours wording and the regular close of the market panel (commit 76b95cf).
decisions: Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-16 (D-027): the six proposals, from information in the filing only.

Proposed: D-028 stage of the IPO instead of a countdown; D-029 lock-up steps not dated or summed (their sum, 15.5 billion, exceeds the shares outstanding); D-030 on a phone the strip replaces the offer and listing lines; D-031 the project's own mark.
